name: SlotNova Booking for WooCommerce
author: Papan Biswas

sections.description: SlotNova Booking for WooCommerce transforms your WooCommerce store into a fully functional booking system designed for SPA centers, salons, and service-based businesses. Allow your customers to book appointments with specific employees, manage timeslots, configure global and product-level availability, and review rich analytics from a beautiful dashboard.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/slotnova-booking directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the SlotNova Booking Settings screen to configure your global opening hours and default durations.
  4. Create a new WooCommerce product and set the product type to ‘SlotNova Booking’.
sections.faq:
Does it require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and activated.
